record.question: 'A' was arrested for the commission of a crime. At the Police Station, 'A' informs the case IO of the location of a property that was involved in the commission of the crime. While proceeding to the location, 'A' confesses to an accompanying witness that he committed the crime and also informed him of the methods he employed in committing the crime. Discuss the legal provisions involved in this transaction along with the admissibility in evidence of the disclosures made by 'A'.
